verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://developers.openai.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index describing the full documentation hub (API, Agentic Commerce, Codex, etc.), and a second llms.txt exists for the Cookbook, both directly enabling an agent to be pointed at machine-readable, agent-oriented doc indexes. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of an agent actually consuming llms.txt successfully, and a working OpenAPI spec (probe found only 404s for openapi.json candidates), which would round out machine-readable API discovery.
